name: Millo Garcia
source:
Millo is Fabian's right hand and the one that works the most to keep Ortiz's reputation safe.

He is flirtatious and a money lover. A combination that usually means trouble.
Although Millo looks like a carefree person, he is very committed to his work. He'll set every boundary aside, if that's what takes him to win.

Lauren talks about Millo being a vicious snake. Cooper says he is sick. But Fabian only sees him as a strong and qualified man for this world's business.
